result.topic_en: Riemann's calculations of Fourier-type integrals of the form int e^{-yy-2yx}/(e^{y eps sqrt pi} - e^{-y eps sqrt pi}) dy (eps = e^{pi i/4}), their Mellin transforms to obtain integral representations of the zeta function, and a saddle-point (stationary phase) asymptotic estimate of log mu(-s).

methods.what: Closed-form evaluation of a Gaussian integral against 1/(e^{y eps sqrt pi}+e^{-y eps sqrt pi}) (Mordell-type integral), eps = e^{pi i/4}
Shift of the integration contour by -eps sqrt(pi)/2 to obtain a sinh-denominator version
Hankel loop integral for the Gamma function
Mellin transform of the Mordell-type identity leading to zeta(s)
Definition of the completed function xi
Integral representation of xi as sum of two integrals (Riemann–Siegel type representation)
Reflection formula for the Gamma function
Definition of mu(-s) as an integral and location of the saddle point
Saddle-point expansion: Taylor expansion of exponent around y = sqrt(s/2)
Resulting asymptotic formula for log mu(-s)
